move: phone and stats slide in, all numbers count up together, ring fills
how: Three lane stripes slide in from the left with expo.out stagger, a phone card from x:-500 rotation -10, a tag and three stat cards from the right, and horizontal lines draw scaleX with expo.inOut; 14 bar-chart bars pop with back.out(2). From 0.14D a proxy object tweens distance, percent, heart rate, calories and pace together with power3.out over 2.2s, painting the text and setting the SVG ring's strokeDashoffset each update; the stat values bump scale 1.04 at 0.58D and the heart rate keeps ticking with sine.inOut tweens. From 0.86D stats and lines retract with expo.in, the phone leaves left, the tag right and the lanes exit right.
adapt: Change the metric labels, target values in the count tween, the ring goal and bar seed, the tag and the accent colour; keep the 2.2s power3.out count and the entrance/exit stagger.
port: mount(el, shot) builds .lane stripes, .phone with ring SVG and generated bars, .stats and .line elements; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the proxy-object count tweens (onUpdate paint) at 0.7/5, 3.1/5 and 3.7/5 of D. paint() must query inside el instead of document; the arc dasharray 276.5 matches r=44.
caveats: paint() uses document.querySelector and must be scoped
strokeDashoffset is set via gsap.set in onUpdate rather than tweened directly
